post_title: 15-year or 30-year loan? Same house, very different money.
caption:
15-year or 30-year? Same house, same down payment. 🏠

There's no wrong answer, just a different goal. Here's what each one buys you:

• Payment: $1,247 vs $1,623 a month. 30-year wins.
• Cash flow: +$107 vs −$268 a month. 30-year wins.
• Total interest: $262K vs $105K. 15-year saves over $150K.
• Equity by year 5: $11K vs $44K. 15-year wins.

Two all. Cash flow now, or a paid-off house sooner.

Example numbers: $250K house, 25% down, 7.0% 30-year vs 6.4% 15-year, rent $2,200, 23% of rent set aside for vacancy, repairs, CapEx and management.
